# alfa — documentation for agents (LLMs)

> Index of all `alfa` documentation. `alfa` is a TypeScript 7 backend framework for
> [Bun](https://bun.com) with zero runtime dependencies. Routing is file-system based
> (`pages/`), delegated to `Bun.FileSystemRouter`; everything else is the Bun-native API.

Full corpus in one file: [llms-full.txt](./llms-full.txt)

## Documentation

- [Overview](https://github.com/nino-ts/alfa/blob/main/docs/index.md): pillars, install, quick start, requirements.
- [Getting started](https://github.com/nino-ts/alfa/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md): install, minimal app, layout, scripts, tsconfig.
- [HTTP](https://github.com/nino-ts/alfa/blob/main/docs/http.md): `HttpContext`, `compose`, response helpers, CSRF, cookies.
- [Routing](https://github.com/nino-ts/alfa/blob/main/docs/routing.md): `pages/`, params, catch-all, `defineApp`, errors, dev.
- [Database](https://github.com/nino-ts/alfa/blob/main/docs/database.md): `defineTable` over `Bun.sql`, migrations.
- [Validation](https://github.com/nino-ts/alfa/blob/main/docs/validation.md): `StandardSchemaV1` adapter, `parse`, `parseBody`.
- [Auth](https://github.com/nino-ts/alfa/blob/main/docs/auth.md): `Bun.password`, opaque tokens, `guard`.
- [Session](https://github.com/nino-ts/alfa/blob/main/docs/session.md): `cookieSession` (HMAC), `redisSession`.
- [Frontend stacks](https://github.com/nino-ts/alfa/blob/main/docs/frontend-stacks.md): HTMX/Alpine, React, Vue, API-only, escaping.
- [CLI](https://github.com/nino-ts/alfa/blob/main/docs/cli.md): `migrate`, `make:page`, `make:migration`.
- [Deployment](https://github.com/nino-ts/alfa/blob/main/docs/deployment.md): compiled binary, Docker, env.

## Sources

- [Repository](https://github.com/nino-ts/alfa)
- Packages `alfa` and `create-alfa` — **not published yet** (see the repo README)
- Bun reference: [bun.com/reference](https://bun.com/reference) and [bun.com/docs](https://bun.com/docs)

## How to consume

**Not on npm yet.** Use the clone:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/nino-ts/alfa && cd alfa && bun install
cd packages/alfa && bun link
```

```ts
import { defineApp } from "alfa";

defineApp().listen(3000);
```

```ts
// pages/index.ts
export default () => "<h1>Hello alfa</h1>";
```

## Conventions

- Routes live in `pages/`: `index.ts` → `/`, `[param].ts`, `[...catchall].ts`, `[[...optionalCatchall]].ts`.
- A route file `export default`s a handler `(ctx) => Response | string`.
- No `layout`, `error`, `not-found`, route groups, parallel or intercepting routes:
  Bun's router does not implement them and `alfa` does not reimplement them.
- The framework exposes no `escapeHtml` helper — use `Bun.escapeHTML()`.
- Tests use `bun:test` (`bun test`) only.
- TypeScript 7, `noEmit`, zero `any`, zero suppressions.
- Bun (>= 1.4) only. Node.js, npm, yarn and pnpm are not supported.
